How to use this calculator

  1. Enter sale amount, commission rate, your share of commission.
  2. Select Calculate to see the answer and its breakdown.
  3. Keep a scenario, change an input and compare the results.

Use consistent units and check the assumptions below before applying the result.

How commission is calculated

The commission amount is calculated from the sale price, commission rate and your share. Contract splits, caps and deductions should be reflected in the entered percentages. Formula: Your commission = sale price × commission rate × your share. Use the displayed details to inspect the intermediate amounts and replace example assumptions with terms from your own quote or records.

Your commission = sale price × commission rate × your share.
A worked example

A 5% commission on a $500,000 sale is $25,000; a 50% share is $12,500.

Assumptions & useful context

The result depends on the values you enter and the method described above. Displayed numbers may be rounded; calculations use the unrounded values. Check that this model matches your situation before relying on it.

Financial projections use your assumptions. Actual returns, lender terms, fees and tax rules can differ; these results do not guarantee a future outcome.

Frequently asked questions

Commission Calculator: what does the result include?

It is the share of the gross commission allocated to you. Enter the contractual split, not the full commission rate, in that field.

Commission Calculator: which assumptions matter most?

No. The amount is before taxes, brokerage fees, caps or other deductions unless you have already adjusted the entered sale or split.
